title: SIU clears cops in Brampton shooting
article: Two Peel Regional officers have been cleared by the provincial Special Investigations unit in the death of a sword-wielding man.
Ronald Smith, 54, was shot to death in mid-April after the officers went to his apartment to arrest him on a failure-to-appear warrant in connection with a driving charge.
Entering the house, a confrontation ensued and an officer opened fire when Smith refused to drop a samurai sword, the SIU said. He was shot three times.
The SIU is a civilian law enforcement agency that investigates incidents involving the police and civilians that have resulted in a serious injury or death.
